articles.description:

articles.title: TAPR: Enhancing LLM Performance with a Task-Aware Prompt Rewriter
articles.description:
arXiv:2607.28657v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) often require carefully crafted prompts to unlock their full potential, which can be a barrier for non-expert users. This work addresses the challenge by introducing a Task-Aware Prompt Rewriter (TAPR), a model that reformulates user prompts into task-optimized prompts with the explicit goal of improving downstream LLM performance. articles.title_zh: TAPR: Enhancing LLM Performance with a Task-Aware Prompt Rewriter

articles.description:

articles.title: EarlyDx: An Admission-Anchored Benchmark for Open-Ended Generation of Evidence-Supported ED-Encounter Diagnoses
articles.description:
arXiv:2607.28788v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Clinical diagnosis at hospital admission must be made rapidly from limited, incomplete evidence. articles.title: How Hard Does It Think? Analyzing Step-Aware Reasoning Energy in LLM Chain-of-Thought Trajectories
articles.description:
